answer: Require every new agent to plant a refundable stake that grows like a garden: each verified, useful transaction waters it, while spam or duplicate signing prunes it. A single identity is the pearl at the center, one hardware-bound key per agent, and peers view behavior through a shared prism of attestations, so a Sybil swarm's identical, low-value activity stands out as a fake cluster. Creating a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents earn theirs back.
